verdict.rationale: Kong's Insomnia (part of the Kong ecosystem) documents pre-request scripts, request chaining with response-value extraction, and shared environment variables, matching the story's need for scripting and data massaging across requests [kong-docs-35, kong-docs-38, kong-docs-34, kong-docs-15]. However, a community hands-on comment explicitly calls Insomnia's JS scripting/glue-code support 'garbage-tier' compared to alternatives, directly contradicting the polish implied by the docs [kong-comm-4]. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of post-response (vs pre-request) scripting, and independent corroboration that scripting works well in practice beyond the negative community report.
